_readme: DATED REMINDERS FOR MIKE. Each one is a question to put to him on or after its date.
`npm run check:branch` - which every /startup runs - prints a REMINDERS DUE box once
`on` has arrived, on both machines, until the entry is removed. Mike asked for this
2026-09-28 when he parked 8.3: 'mark this as parked with an automated reminder to ask
A reminder is removed only in the session that puts it to him, with his answer written
where `where` points. It fires only when a session is opened: if none is opened on the
day, it shows at the next one. scripts/reminders.js reads this; tests/unit/reminders.test.js
checks every entry is well formed and names an item that exists.

reminders.ask: Has OpenAI said whether a speaker-labelling successor to gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize is coming before its removal on 26 Feb 2027? Meeting Review needs one, or a fallback he rules on.
